curatedMovie.curiosityHook: Can two solitary people, worn down by dead-end routines and dashed ambitions, build something lasting from a tentative spark?
curatedMovie.description: In Finland, a rubbish collector facing a failed business plan finds an unexpected connection with a cashier he meets at a supermarket.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: A thoughtful, emotionally grounded Finnish romance moving at a steady, compact pace—ideal for an intimate solo or date-night watch.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: Aki Kaurismäki balances working-class vulnerability with understated romance, delivering a lean, soulful drama about finding tentative companionship amidst quiet personal setbacks.
